name: Arm Circles
tips: Small to big circles, forward then backward

name: Cat-Cow

name: Hip Circles

Switch direction halfway

name: Leg Swings

Hold something for balance; front-to-back swings

Lunge, elbow to instep, then rotate and reach up

Knees track over toes

Press up and slightly in; don't flare the ribs
